about: Questions a player might ask the client, each labelled with the hidden requirement it should reveal, or null for one that must reveal nothing. Worded differently from the requirements' own phrasings on purpose: the matcher is measured on how it generalises, not on finding its own examples. Several null questions are traps that share words with a requirement. Written by Claude for the first measurement (exchange 27); questions written by the author are the better test and belong here too. Each question has a set: "dev" is the set the threshold was chosen on (exchange 27), "fresh" was added afterwards (exchange 28) and is measured without changing anything - the honest number for questions the matcher has never been tuned on.
